title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Fox Theatre, St Louis | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fabulous Fox Theatre in St Louis, Missouri, USA, on 7 September 2018.

It was the 28th show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Starr had previously performed at the Fox Theatre on 21 August 2001 and 3 October 2014. He returned there on 23 September 2023.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
